topic: per-task ceremony lives in the task worktree
lesson: Run ./forge task start <id> FIRST, set ./forge ceremony target to the new worktree, then author the task plan, release the task cold read, take the human round, task approve, stage start and delegate — all inside that worktree. Doing plan/grill/approve in the main checkout first re-stales the task grill and approval against the worktree's tree and drops the newest AskUserQuestion ledger records from the mirror (cache-bug-T1, 2026-09-09).
